ivr.steps: Call from the phone number you want to register. Listen to the instructions and press 1 only if you agree to register.
ivr.copyManual: Copying was unavailable. The number is selected; copy it manually or write it down.
ivr.handoff: This opens your calling application. On a computer, copy the number and call from the phone you want to register. Opening the dialer does not create an account.
ivr.after: Returning from the call does not confirm registration. Continue to sign in to check your account through PhoneMail.
ivr.webAlternative: You can use the available registration methods above. No call is placed from this page.
ivr.noPassword: A phone-call registration does not give you a password. Web access requires verification-code sign-in to be enabled for call-created accounts; password setup is not available here.
composer.recipientsChanged: Recipients changed during confirmation. Check them and try again.
composer.saveFailed: Could not save. Review the error and retry.
composer.encryptionOn: End-to-end encryption selected. Sending requires unlocked keys and verified recipient fingerprints.
composer.encryptionOff: End-to-end encryption is off for this message.
composer.modeBusy: Wait for the current operation before changing encryption.
composer.modeDraft: This draft already has a fixed encryption mode. Start a new message to choose another mode.
composer.modeThread: This conversation fixes the encryption mode. Start a separate new message to choose another mode.
composer.modeFiles: Remove the attachments before changing encryption mode.
composer.modeSaving: Wait for the draft to finish saving before changing encryption.
composer.draftsUpdated: Saved draft list updated. New drafts appear on the newest page.
composer.localDraftUpdated: Saved draft is available on this device.
